sections.heading: You are chatting with an AI

fullText:
Return to homepage

Need help?

Contact us
You are chatting with an AI

You are chatting with an AI that answers your questions about Lanserhof and recommends suitable programmes.

Using the chat is voluntary. If you do not consent, there is no disadvantage for you; you can also send us your questions via our contact form.

We protect your data

Personal details such as names or email addresses are detected automatically and replaced with placeholders.

The AI model never sees your data.

Processing in Europe only

Your messages are pseudonymized and processed exclusively in the EU.

We do not store them permanently. When the chat ends, the history is deleted.

Less is more

We do not need your name or contact details to make a suitable recommendation.

Share only what matters for your question, such as your goals or when you would like to visit. Information about your health is voluntary: you decide what you tell us.

Your consent
I expressly consent to the processing of my details as described. If I voluntarily share information about my health in the chat, my consent expressly also covers this health data (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).

You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future: click “Withdraw consent” at the bottom of the chat or delete the cookie “ai_consent_version” in your browser. The lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal remains unaffected. You can find more information in our privacy policy, section “AI assistant”.

Next

You are chatting with an AI assistant, and every response is machine-generated. Our AI can make mistakes and is not a substitute for medical advice.
